verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own agentic workflows (screening, transaction monitoring and remediation agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of MCP client support or any way to connect third-party tool servers to those agents. Its REST API, webhooks, OpenAPI schema and llms.txt are integration surfaces for external consumers, not an MCP client capability, so they earn no credit.
